description:
Preview one of the unit projects for Khan Academy's Intro to Computer Science - Python course!

Autonomous robots use hardware sensors like cameras, radar, and GPS to collect information about the world around them. Their software then processes that data to decide what to do next - all without human input! At each step, the robot observes its surroundings, decides which action best meets its goals, and then acts.
